trust_decision.summary: Route-owner-controlled HTTPRoute/GRPCRoute match values (path, header name/value, query name/value, gRPC service/method) are spliced raw into single-quoted CEL literals that decide which wasm ActionSet (and so which gateway-level override policy) applies to a request; nothing escapes or validates them in internal/wasm/utils.go.

landing_point.why: Summary names internal/wasm and 'httproute match values'; PredicatesFromHTTPRouteMatch is the only function converting HTTPRouteMatch to CEL (doc at internal/wasm/doc.go:16).

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTPRoute spec.rules[].matches[].path (k8s API object reconciled by istio/envoy-gateway extension reconcilers -> BuildActionSetsForPath)

fix_sites.module_kind: core config generator (second copy for gRPC)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: internal/wasm/utils.go:739-745 and internal/wasm/utils.go:758-800 (GRPCRoute predicate builders, same file)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report says 'httproute match values'; GRPCRoute builders are a different route kind, and gRPC service/method look constrained to identifier syntax, so a solver can argue they are not attacker-shaped.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: RegularExpression path matches and regex gRPC service/method must still compile to working CEL .matches() regexes (backslashes kept meaningful, tests pin e.g. '^/com\.example\..*'); header/query values and paths may legitimately contain an apostrophe (Gateway API path charset allows ') so rejecting quotes breaks valid routes.

O6_input_shapes: path value for Exact / PathPrefix / RegularExpression / default type

O7_producer.where: internal/wasm/utils.go:537-601 (BuildSkeletonActionSetsForRoute, called from internal/extension/registry.go:283) and internal/wasm/utils.go:314 (BuildActionSetsForPath)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GRPCRoute method.service / method.method spliced raw into url_path == / startsWith / matches literals
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Report is about HTTPRoute; gRPC service/method appear identifier-restricted by the Gateway API CRD (not verifiable here, especially for RegularExpression type).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~60 lines below the HTTP builders

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A route- or policy-derived value rendered into a single-quoted literal via the existing double-quote escaper escapeCELString
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: escapeCELString escapes only \ " \n \r \t; a maintainer reusing it for '...' literals would believe the value was escaped.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An extension-side skeleton builder that renders route matches to CEL itself instead of via PredicatesFromHTTPRouteMatch
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Extensions (cmd/extensions/*) already build their own CEL strings with Sprintf, so a second, extension-package predicate builder is a plausible duplicate at distance.

O9_family: CEL expression injection (CWE-917) in generated data-plane predicates -> policy/override bypass

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.26.7 (go.mod:3), controller-gen via make generate; sigs.k8s.io/gateway-api v1.2.1
O10_build.project_tests: internal/wasm/utils_test.go (TestPredicatesFromHTTPRouteMatch:235, TestPredicatesFromGRPCRouteMatch:283), internal/wasm/action_spec_test.go (escapeCELString); make test-unit (Makefile:429). Integration suites tests/istio, tests/envoygateway need a cluster.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap path/header/query values with the existing escapeCELString, which does not escape single quotes, or reject quotes/backslashes outright and break regex and apostrophe-bearing matches.
